items.title: Release v0.27.4
items.en_oneliner: In Qwen Code 0.27.4, managed agents can reach approved folders on your machine and launch a web terminal that keeps no credentials, and results can go to Feishu.

items.title: SDK TypeScript Release v0.1.34
items.en_oneliner: The Qwen Code TypeScript SDK moves to 0.1.34, bundling CLI version 0.27.4.

items.title: Qwen Code Desktop v0.27.4
items.en_oneliner: Qwen Code Desktop reaches 0.27.4, letting managed agent sessions access granted local directories and open the overview from the footer.
